integrity: An analytical proof establishes all-n bounds and extremizers. Exhaustive labeled n=2,3 checks and sampled larger tests supplement but do not substitute for proof. Independent scientific verification has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Complete strict balanced one-to-one preferences, utility n-r only; comparison of men-proposing deferred acceptance against Nash-optimal stable matching; n=2 degeneracy; no general cardinal-value or incomplete-list conclusion.
title: Sharp Nash-welfare gap for proposer-optimal stable marriage
